exactMismatch.semanticAssessment: For these constraint-free primitive branches, both forms admit string or number style values. The implemented checker does not canonicalize between these forms.

checkChain.behavior: The single reviewed update_styles profile encodes styles.additionalProperties with anyOf.
semantic_schema removes description/title/examples/$comment prose and sorts required/enum arrays. It preserves $schema, legitimate named fields, union encodings and nested shapes.

_same_reviewed_json compares canonical encoded JSON. compatible_tool_contract accepts equality or a narrowly defined optional top-level extension whose removal yields equality. This nested representation difference yields None.

schema_receipt computes eligibility separately for each edit tool. Any qualified writer plus the critical snapshot/server checks can make accepted_for_write true while update_styles remains incompatible.
paper_catalog projects incompatible edit tools as edit_held_schema.
If called, qualify_call_arguments would refuse this tool as TOOL_SCHEMA_CHANGED before requested dispatch. No such call was made in this diagnosis.

offlineProof.method: Execute only the unmodified pinned pure comparison functions/constants against the cached native descriptor, outside the bridge runtime.
offlineProof.limit: The diagnostic counterfactual is not a runtime repair, installed profile or authorization to dispatch.

alreadyQualifiedPaths.use: Reports the current actual descriptor and per-tool write classification. A fresh observation can prove a genuinely changed compatible state; re-reading unchanged f200 does not repair this mismatch.
The pinned source exposes write_schema readiness and checks the critical snapshot getter. Readiness is not per-tool permission and does not make the held update_styles callable.
Continue only where the actual operation preserves the target's required content, geometry and stacking. Tool admission does not certify clone fidelity.

repairAssessment.reason: There is one update_styles reviewed profile and no primitive-union normalization. Optional-root-field tolerance cannot apply to this nested field.
repairAssessment.boundedSourceRepairCandidate: A source-owned additional update_styles profile for this exact native union encoding, with all other types/constraints/required fields and destructive annotations unchanged, would address the isolated mismatch more narrowly than broad schema-equivalence normalization. This report does not add or activate that profile.
repairAssessment.existingProcess: docs/PAPER_DESIGN_INTEGRATION.md lines116–120 requires an explicit source-reviewed update for a changed qualified contract. docs/PAPER_DIRECT_CHATGPT.md lines54–56 separates reviewed source merge, installer selection and real guarded acceptance. The existing runtime owner/release path must apply; no checksum override, hotpatch, private test seam or newly invented control is qualified here.
repairAssessment.privateSeamBoundary: bridge.py lines989–1003 and1126–1129 explicitly identify custom catalog-pin behavior as an internal test seam, unavailable to normal MCP/CLI callers. It is not a repair path.

zIndexImplication.parentReported: A style-only clone and an explicit clone z-index override both yielded fully observed 47-node replacements that lost original zIndex100; two native backups are verified.
zIndexImplication.scope: This is separate from descriptor qualification: the schema hold prevents the intended targeted style API from being admitted, while the clone result is an upstream preservation failure after an admitted operation.
zIndexImplication.noGuarantee: Even a subsequently qualified update_styles would still need exact zIndex and graph readback on the real target. Its native description says context-inert styles can be ignored and returned in ignoredStyles; schema equivalence alone cannot promise runtime style behavior.
